channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: David Njoku (fibula) is questionable for Week 10 against the Ravens.
item.description: Njoku logged a week of limited sessions before drawing the questionable tag for Monday Night Football. He will need to be activated from injured reserve prior to Monday to play. Fantasy managers are likely better off making alternate plans considering the Chargers don’t play until Monday.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Ladd McConkey (back) is questionable for Week 10 against the Ravens.
item.description: McConkey heads into Monday Night Football listed as questionable after failing to practice through Friday. The veteran receiver missed Week 9 when it was revealed he had been dealing with back spasms during warmups. Fantasy managers are likely better off making alternate plans considering the Chargers play in the final game of the week.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Packers activated RB Chris Brooks and WR Skyy Moore from injured reserve.
item.description: Brooks returns to a backfield once again without Josh Jacobs, appearing likely to serve as the preferred passing down back while Kaleb Johnson handles early-down duties. Moore remains unlikely to be consistently involved in the offense but brings a sizable boost to the special teams unit. The top duo of Christian Watson and Matthew Golden should continue to dominate targets through the air for one of the most pass-heavy offenses in the league.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Patriots placed RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) on injured reserve.
item.description: Henderson will now miss the coming four games, at minimum, after missing the previous two, with what the team is calling neurological symptoms. Whatever it is that Henderson is currently going through is clearly bigger than football. Rhamondre Stevenson is currently listed as questionable for Week 10 but is not expected to play, leaving the backfield in the hands of Corey Kiner in the immediate future. Here’s hoping for a speedy recovery for the electric running back.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Panthers activated WR Xavier Legette (knee) from injured reserve.
item.description: Legette will make his return to a passing offense currently dominated by Tetairoa McMillan, Jalen Coker, and tight end Darren Waller, unlikely to return a usable fantasy score in his first game since Week 2. He is not on the fantasy radar despite the plus matchup against the Saints.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Panthers downgraded Jonathon Brooks (core) to out for Week 10 against the Saints.
item.description: Brooks will miss his seventh consecutive game as he attempts to return from a core muscle injury. He managed a week of limited sessions before initially being listed as doubtful, ultimately ruled out. Chuba Hubbard will again serve as a legitimate workhorse in a plus matchup against the Saints and can be treated as a back-end RB1 in Week 10.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Cowboys placed RB Tyler Goodson (ankle/knee) on injured reserve.
item.description: It’s yet another blow to the depth of a backfield devastated by injuries this season, leaving lead back Javonte Williams again positioned well to see a workhorse role against the 49ers. The team elevated running back Israel Abanikanda in an associated move, who is likely to serve as the primary change of pace option in Week 10.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Texans ruled out David Montgomery (groin) for Week 10 against the Browns.
item.description: Montgomery entered the weekend listed as questionable after missing the previous three games plus the team’s Week 8 bye. Fantasy managers will have to wait another week for his return, while Woody Marks retains viable FLEX status playing as the top option alongside recent signee Emari Demercado.-Mark Garcia

item.title: Pat Freiermuth (illness) is questionable for Week 10 against the Bengals.
item.description: Freiermuth was added to the injury report Saturday as questionable with an illness. A mid-range TE2 when healthy, Freiermuth’s potential absence likely wouldn’t change much for Darnell Washington’s fantasy outlook. Fantasy managers counting on Freiermuth will need to be proactive about alternative options as the Steelers play the Bengals on Sunday Night Football, which airs on NBC and Peacock.-Nick Shlain

item.title: CBS Sports’ Matt Zenitz reports Omar Cooper (ankle) is expected to play in Week 10 against the Bills.
item.description: Cooper seemed to be trending in the right direction this week as he got in a full practice on Friday. Now he’s expected to play against the Bills, according to Zenitz. Cooper led the Jets in targets last week and will be in the WR3 mix against Buffalo this week.-Nick Shlain
